note: USACE Kanopolis Lake campground on the Smoky Hill River just below the dam. Sites 1-9 back onto a steep riverbank (the Corps warns it may be dangerous to unattended children). In April and October-November the electricity stays on but water and the flush restrooms may close for freezing; a vault restroom stays open. --Claude
summary: rec.gov confirms 50A/water (16 E/W, 8 primitive), fees 16-24 as stored (2026-27 tables), weekend 2/holiday 3 min, 14 max; sites 27 -> 24, pull_through added, facilities added. Riverview confirmed (river behind a wooded steep bank). Pin fine.
flags: Phone 785-546-2294 (Kanopolis Project Office) confirmed on the rec.gov page. Website https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/233601 confirmed.

Waterfront (stored riverview): CONFIRMED, not raised. recreation.gov tags sites 001-009 'Waterfront Sites' and warns they 'back up to a steep riverbank'. On imagery those pads sit ~25-40 m from the Smoky Hill River with a band of trees on the bank between (leaf-off Esri shows the water through it; NAIP summer is closed canopy), so there is no open apron to the water. River-in-view through the bank trees = riverview. The Waterfront tag would be the only basis for riverfront, and the wooded steep bank fails the open-land rule. The lake itself is upstream behind the dam: no lake value.
Pin 38.6105,-97.9566 sits in the middle of the loop among sites 22/25: fine.

Fees left as stored (16-24): the 2026-2027 rec.gov tables give peak (May-Sep) electric & water $24 (30 and 50 A alike), primitive $18; non-peak (Apr, Oct-Nov) utility $18, primitive $16. Primitive sites 010/011 take 45-50 ft RVs, so the $16 base is a site EKKO fits. Group shelter $20 is not camping.
Primitive sites 015-017, 021 and 027 allow only pickup campers/camper vans up to 19-20 ft (no RV equipment): not EKKO sites; 010, 011 and 028 are. Site 022 is MANAGEMENT (not available).
fcfs left unset: no walk-up without paying on recreation.gov is described; the 'Not Reservable' reservationCutOff rule has no value.
Season left unset: the rate seasons run April-November and the notice describes April and October-November service, but rec.gov gives no opening or closing statement for the campground.
militaryDiscount rule on the facility is rec.gov's standard rule, not a discount claim: not written.
